children: Destination XL Group, Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $111.6M and net income of $2M, or diluted EPS of $0.04, versus revenue of $115.5M and a net loss in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue was $111.6M for Q2 FY2026, down from $115.5M in the year-ago quarter (−3.4% YoY).
Net income was $2.0M for Q2 FY2026, compared with a net loss of $0.3M in the year-ago quarter (improvement YoY).
Diluted earnings per share were $0.04 for Q2 FY2026, versus $(0.00) in the year-ago quarter (YoY improvement).
Total sales declined 3.5% year over year in the quarter and 2.8% year to date, driven by a 3.6% comparable sales decrease.
Store traffic lagged and stores underperformed, while the direct business showed resilience with stronger digital marketing results.
Gross margin improved largely due to a $4.6M tariff refund, which was partially offset by higher shipping costs and increased markdowns; occupancy costs showed deleveraging.
Operational investments include rollout of FiTMAP in 188 stores (about 150k users) and AI initiatives to improve fit, product discoverability and product data.
Inventory was down 4.3% with clearance approaching the company's ~10% benchmark; the store fleet remained stable at 293 locations with targeted capital spending focused on technology.
